.create-or-alter function
with (
    folder = "GridPulse/RealTime",
    docstring = "Gap-aware rolling 15/30/60 minute GridPulse Real-Time price metrics over current eligible state."
)
fn_rt_price_rolling()
{
    let base = materialize(
        fn_rt_price_current()
        | extend market_day_index = datetime_diff(
            "day",
            todatetime(delivery_date),
            datetime(1970-01-01)
        )
        | extend market_slot_ordinal =
              tolong(market_day_index) * 288
            + tolong(delivery_hour - 1) * 12
            + tolong(['interval'] - 1)
        | project
            delivery_date,
            delivery_hour,
            interval_no = ['interval'],
            market_slot_ordinal,
            price = todouble(zonal_price_capped_cad_per_mwh),
            event_id,
            source_hash,
            event_created_at_utc
    );
    let window_specs = datatable(
        window_minutes:int,
        expected_slots:int
    )
    [
        15, 3,
        30, 6,
        60, 12
    ];
    base
    | extend join_key = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        window_specs
        | extend join_key = 1
    ) on join_key
    | project-away join_key, join_key1
    | extend offset = range(0, expected_slots - 1, 1)
    | mv-expand offset to typeof(long)
    | extend expected_slot =
        market_slot_ordinal - offset
    | join kind=leftouter (
        base
        | project
            expected_slot = market_slot_ordinal,
            matched_price = price
    ) on expected_slot
    | summarize
        matched_slots = countif(isnotnull(matched_price)),
        raw_avg = avg(matched_price),
        raw_min = min(matched_price),
        raw_max = max(matched_price),
        raw_stddev = stdev(matched_price)
        by
            delivery_date,
            delivery_hour,
            interval_no,
            market_slot_ordinal,
            window_minutes,
            expected_slots,
            event_id,
            source_hash,
            event_created_at_utc
    | extend window_complete =
        matched_slots == expected_slots
    | extend
        rolling_avg = iff(
            window_complete,
            raw_avg,
            real(null)
        ),
        rolling_min = iff(
            window_complete,
            raw_min,
            real(null)
        ),
        rolling_max = iff(
            window_complete,
            raw_max,
            real(null)
        ),
        rolling_stddev = iff(
            window_complete,
            raw_stddev,
            real(null)
        )
    | project
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        interval_no,
        window_minutes,
        expected_slots,
        matched_slots,
        window_complete,
        rolling_avg,
        rolling_min,
        rolling_max,
        rolling_stddev,
        event_id,
        source_hash,
        event_created_at_utc
}
